lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gills. The spots in the central rows exhibit greater spacing than those in the dorsal-most rows. A high-density cluster of smaller, less organized spots is present in the region immediately posterior to the final gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern. These bands are most prominent on the mid-lateral flank where they align with the vertical placement of the larger blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior margin and distinct shadowing on the inferior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of spots, with a transition from larger, distinct blobs at the base to finer, more concentrated stippling towards the distal trailing edge.
